name: Boardify OAuth
description: GitHub OAuth provider for Sveltia CMS (Boardify).

OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your GitHub OAuth App.

OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of your GitHub OAuth App.

SECRET_KEY.description: Random string used to sign the session cookie (OAuth state).

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated origins of the Boardify CMS (e.g. https://boardify.example.com). Tokens are only posted to these.

GIT_HOSTNAME.description: Optional: GitHub Enterprise URL. Leave blank for github.com.

SCOPES.description: Optional: OAuth scopes to request.  Defaults to repo,user
